## Release checks

| Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit application suite | Passed: 74 tests across the three engines; 4 platform-specific export cases intentionally skipped |

## Acceptance focus

The v0.8.6 browser checks must confirm that multi-record input initially opens Self
plot; Bases is the initial exact view; exact plots use full footprints without geometry
or exact-panel direction controls; the base legend is titled **Base**; and the product
and landing-page text match the release notes. Existing v0.8.5 numeric full-footprint
and no-interpolation regressions remain applicable.

The final browser run also covers clearing a Direction-colored exact session and
loading a new input: Similarity and the Bases view are restored, so the Base legend
and default coloring cannot be masked by state from the previous session.

## Remaining release-finalization scope

This workspace is an extracted source directory rather than a Git checkout. Annotated
tagging, clean-commit provenance, reproducible source/binary archive generation, and
remote release publication remain outside this local comparison build.
